commits.label: Commits
commits.description: Count commits by committedAt, including merge commits and all authors.

pullRequests.label: Pull requests opened
pullRequests.description: Count pull requests by createdAt, regardless of their later state. A pull request and a commit can describe the same work.

lines.label: Lines changed
lines.description: Sum insertions plus deletions for non-merge commits, grouped by committedAt. Merge commits are excluded to avoid counting edits again at merge time. Includes all file types recorded by Git, including generated files and formatting changes; measures editing volume, not quality or productivity.

tokens.label: AI tokens
tokens.description: Sum fresh input, cached input, cache-write input, and output tokens by minuteAt. Includes the repository’s recorded worktree and subfolder usage. An operation is assigned to the minute of its usage record, rather than spread over its duration.

cost.label: Estimated AI cost (US dollars)
cost.description: Sum costUsd from token_usage_with_cost by minuteAt. Uses the latest stored model-price version in each database for every date. This is an estimate from public model prices, not an invoice or subscription payment. Unpriced records produce a partial estimate; completely unpriced days are unavailable.
